title: Text animations
summary: Title cards and text overlays in the archive-documentary look: tall condensed capitals in off-white, crimson brush strokes and label bars, torn paper sheets and silver prints on a near-black navy table, typewritten references and old book italics, all under grain, dust and a projector flicker. Words settle, bars wipe, small text types on, and every card keeps drifting slowly; nothing bounces.
usage: Title cards fill the frame (any shape from square to 9:16): use one as a shot's "background", e.g. {"background": {"piece": "text/headline-slam", "props": {"lines": ["YOUR", "WORDS"], "field": "night"}}}, or as a footage "cutaway". Fields: night, steel, crimson, paper, sepia (field and colour names from other themes are mapped onto these). Cards with a photograph take "scene" (city, portrait, landscape, ship, group, ruins) or "image" (a URL, shown monochrome). Overlays are see-through, in 1080×1920 frame pixels: {"piece": "text/lower-third", "start": 1.2, "end": 3.4, "props": {"name": "…", "y": 1690}}. Every word, colour and position is a prop. Kit: library/themes/historical/kit.js. Files: library/themes/historical/text/pieces/.

items.name: Headline
items.description: An archival print lies tilted on the table while the headline sets itself in tall capitals across its lower edge, the last line over a crimson brush stroke.

items.name: Split stack
items.description: Two words stacked either side of a long panoramic print, one setting from the left above it and one from the right below.

items.name: Ticker wall
items.description: Rows of newsreel tickers crawling slowly in alternating directions: bold capitals, crimson bands, outlines, typewriter and serif.

items.name: Statement
items.description: One sentence set word by word in tall capitals on a torn sheet of bone paper; accent words print in crimson with a brush underline, then a stamp is pressed on.

items.name: Big number
items.description: A year or figure in huge numerals on a torn charcoal block, counting up, with a label bar, a tick rule and a note.

items.name: Quote page
items.description: A quotation as a page from the archive: old book italic appearing line by line, a large crimson quotation mark, the source on a stacked caption.

items.name: Contents
items.description: A contents page: the title over a brush stroke, then numbered entries wiping on one by one along a thin line, the newest number in crimson.

items.name: Then and now
items.description: Two prints of the same place in different photographic tones, one above the other, each with its word on a bar, a torn paper strip between them.

items.name: Era card
items.description: A chapter number in very large numerals with "Chapter" written across it in copperplate, the title on a bar, a tick rule and a pressed stamp.

items.name: Film leader
items.description: A film-leader countdown: rings, cross-hairs and a sweeping wedge, the count stepping down with a flash on each change, then the go word on a bar.

items.name: End card
items.description: A closing card set like a silent-film intertitle: a double-ruled frame, the sign-off between ornament rules, a call to action, the handle typed on, and a slow ticker band.

items.name: Keyword slam
items.description: One word in tall capitals arriving letter by letter on a band of colour dragged across the frame by a dry brush, with a typed kicker.

items.name: Highlight swipe
items.description: A sentence on dark strips; a bar of colour wipes in behind the words you mark.

items.name: Lower third
items.description: The stacked caption: optional year box, name on a crimson bar, role on a dark strip, over a brush stroke.

items.name: Side text
items.description: A ledger-spine label running up one edge: torn charcoal strip, brush stroke and a small end bar.

items.name: Marquee band
items.description: A slowly scrolling newsreel title band on torn colour with a thin typed strip running the other way.

items.name: Corner labels
items.description: Archive markings in the four corners on bars and typed strips, with brush strokes and a catalogue letter on a paper tab.

items.name: Picture frame
items.description: An aged paper mount with photo corners and tape around an empty window, with a label bar and caption.

items.name: Sticker
items.description: A round archive stamp pressed onto a torn, taped paper slip.
